---
title: "Figures that follow the toggle"
---

A cell can emit a light output and a dark output. Put the light output first:

```python
#| renderings: [light, dark]
```

With `askr-html` and `theme-toggle`, the dark stylesheet carries
`data-mode="dark"`, and the toggle adds `quarto-dark` to `body`. The
[Figures](../components/figures.qmd) page renders a pair of swatches this way.
